description: Implement Kafka integration, JWT security configuration, REST controllers, and API documentation
steps: Create KafkaConfig.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/config/ following account-service pattern with ConsumerFactory and KafkaListenerContainerFactory for FundTransferCompletedEvent.
Create KafkaProducerService.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/kafka/ for publishing FundTransferCompletedEvent to bank-transfer-topic.
Create SecurityConfig.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/config/ with JWT filter configuration, role-based authorization (CUSTOMER for transfers, ADMIN for viewing all transfers).
Create JwtFilter.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/security/ to validate Authorization tokens.

Create TransferController.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/controller/ with endpoints: POST /api/transfers, GET /api/transfers/{transactionReference}, GET /api/transfers/history with filtering by date range and status.
Add OpenAPI/Swagger configuration in SecurityConfig or separate OpenApiConfig class.
Update application.yaml in src/main/resources/ to add Kafka configuration: spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers: localhost:9092, producer/consumer properties.
Add JWT secret configuration to application.yaml: jwt.secret, jwt.expiration.
Create GlobalExceptionHandler.java in src/main/java/com/revana/bank/transaction/exception/ to handle all custom exceptions and return proper HTTP status codes.
Add @PreAuthorize annotations to controller methods for role-based access control.
acceptance_criteria: Controllers return proper HTTP status codes (201 for created, 200 for success, 400 for validation errors, 401 for unauthorized, 403 for forbidden)
JWT filter validates tokens and extracts user roles
Global exception handler catches all custom exceptions
verification: Run mvn clean compile to verify code compiles
Test that application starts with security configuration
Verify Kafka producer configuration matches account-service pattern
